summary: Add the member-local phone-command daemon module without activating phone commands

replay.detail: Command records are bounded process-local memory; no durable replay is introduced.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers or migrations change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or coordinated member upgrade change.

compatibility.detail: This module implements the landed phone-command v1 message_id contract but adds no router, capability or collection-stream wiring. It does not activate live phone commands or change the exposed protocol.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption is introduced by this inactive module.

manual.detail: No installation or phone activation steps are required; routing and stream integration are not included.

recovery.detail: No persistent command state or recovery behavior changes; existing daemon swap-back conditions are unchanged.
